description: Explicit /teach in an empty workspace: no mission yet, so the first job is to ask why.
prompt: /teach Rust ownership and borrowing. I'm a CS student and know C++ well.

assertions.desc: The assistant looked for MISSION.md or the learning records before acting.
The reply asks the user why they want to learn this (the mission or goal) before teaching.
No lesson or reference file was created before the mission is known.
The reply does not lecture on ownership rules from the assistant's own knowledge.
The reply tells the user how the workspace will work over several sessions (mission, lessons, references, learning records or resources).
